titles.romaji: H.P. Lovecraft no Dunwich Horror Sonohoka no Monogatari
titles.native: H・P・ラヴクラフトの　ダニッチ・ホラー　その他の物語

description: Three classic H.P. Lovecraft stories are brought to life by animated clay puppets and miniatures. They are "The picture in the house", "The Dunwich horror" and "The festival".
